newsitem.title: FRANCE: SEB in offer for Arno control.
newsitem.headline: SEB in offer for Arno control.

text.p: French domestic appliance maker SEB said on Thursday that it struck a deal with a group of shareholders of Brazilian electrical appliance maker Arno, gaving it control of almost all Arno voting rights.
It was now going to make an offer to other shareholders on the same basis, it said in a statement.
Under the terms, Arno would be valued at around $270 million.

"The SEB group will propose the acquistion of shares from all other shareholders under the same conditions, in each category, but limited to 60 percent of preference shares to maintain their bourse listing," it said.
Arno had turnover of the equivalent of around 1.5 billion francs in 1996 and net profit of 165 million francs, it said, adding that the firm employed about 3,500 staff at five sites in Sao Paolo.
